title: DEPHYRIER Ssylka Istekla (Auth Dance)
style: auth-dance anthem, 89 bpm, English Russian transliteration French trilingual, deadpan link-expired recital, terminal core, fresh-link chant, DEPHYRIER signature, slack-thread groove, webhook-required flow
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Authentication link expired Cursor reply
March seventh fresh one in the thread sky
The link the timeout the operator pressed
React emoji on the message blessed

[Pre-Chorus — Russian transliteration]
Ssylka istekla nuzhna novaya
DEPHYRIER vremya prishla svezhaya
(Link expired need a new one / DEPHYRIER fresh time has come)

[Chorus — trilingual]
Fresh link link expired ssylka istekla
The timeout chain the auth dance shtekla
March seventh April sixth same shape
The operator clicks the agent escapes

[Verse 2 — English]
The operator asked for all of your functions
March seventh in the Cursor thread junctions
Code to share with Claude Ops CLI four six
VPS webhook link required to mix

[Bridge — Russian transliteration]
Kod podelit'sya s Claude Ops CLI
Webhook URL nuzhen ne lyubi
(Code share with Claude Ops CLI / Webhook URL needed not loved)

[Outro — trilingual]
Fresh link ssylka istekla expired chain
The auth dance the lane the same refrain
